title: Cloud Security: incident recording
content:
Cloud Security incident recording is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration in hours and recorded availability percentage from the official operational report.

No customer statement substitutes for the report.

Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though the outage credit basis excludes them.

Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

## Basis Q&A

**Does recording an incident change finances or contract status?**

Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

## Excluded incident record

Hypothetical case: the operational report identifies scheduled maintenance. Its incident record remains visible with that cause; registering the incident does not create a credit.
